execution.description: Checked the two files with Black's in-process format_file_contents API to avoid launcher stalls.

expected: The API would return formatted text for direct comparison.
observed: Black raised its NothingChanged control signal on the first file; the one-line checker did not catch that signal, so it exited before checking the second file. This is positive evidence for only the first file, not a complete pass.
keep: Use an in-process formatting API on this host.
change: Use Black format_str, which returns text instead of raising NothingChanged, for a complete two-file comparison.
